==Hero Usage==
* In all PvE maps aside from the [[Isle of the Nameless]] training grounds, Heroes will only use Mistrust against enemy spellcasters.

== Notes == 
*This spell's animation is similar to those of some [[Paragon]] skills like [["Fall Back!"]] and [[Focused Anger]], as well as the [[Ritualist]] skill [[Destructive Was Glaive]].
*This hex works slightly different depending on whether or not the target is casting an enemy-targeting spell when this hex is first applied to them. If not, the effect will immediately trigger the next time the target tries to cast an enemy-targeting spell. If so, the effect will trigger upon the enemy-targeting spell finishing its activation (if the hex remains on them). 
*Note that since only directly enemy-targeting spells will be affected self-centered spells such as [[Shockwave]] will be unaffected. 

{{anomaly|Mistrust will take effect if the hexed character attempts to cast a spell on ''any'' NPC hostile to them, including other foes. For example, in [[Varajar Fells]], an [[Ice Imp]]'s [[Maelstrom]] will fail if they attempt to cast it on a [[Modniir Hunter]].}}
